The business analyst interview guide

The questions hiring managers actually ask business analysts, and how to answer them in a way that shows judgement, not memorised theory.

What you'll learn

  • The question types that come up in almost every BA interview, and what each one is really testing
  • How to structure scenario answers around real situations from your own experience
  • How to talk about requirements, stakeholders and process work if you're coming from a different role
  • The mistakes that quietly cost strong candidates the offer

Written by Tosin Ogunkoya, drawing on thirteen years in business analysis and more than three thousand people trained.

Questions about the guide

Who is the BA interview guide for?

Anyone preparing for a business analyst interview, from career changers going for a first BA role to experienced analysts stepping up to senior positions.

Is the guide really free?

Yes. Enter your email, confirm your address, and the guide is sent to your inbox. You'll also get one practical BA lesson a week, and you can unsubscribe at any time.
